mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, name, sort_order, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, is_deleted, deleted_time FROM product_categories WHERE id = #{categoryId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, parent_id, name, sort_order, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, is_deleted, deleted_time FROM product_categories WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY sort_order DESC, updated_time DESC

SELECT id, parent_id, name, sort_order, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, is_deleted, deleted_time FROM product_categories WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, updated_time DESC
